_note: Maintainer-curated catalog. 'id' is a Chrome Web Store extension ID; the Add button fetches that package through /v1/api/crx/:id. These IDs were entered from memory and should be verified against the live Web Store before relying on them (a wrong ID just makes that one Add button error). For a self-hosted package instead, drop the file in public/store/packages/ and use { "name": "...", "path": "/store/packages/file.zip", ... }. Add an "icon" URL per entry for a real logo; otherwise a category glyph is shown.
